subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `lint-incidents`, docgate shall verify the registry at its configured path is append-only vs the merge base — committed `I<n>` blocks immutable except the sanctioned `Links:`-line growth — and that each entry carries a dense `I<n>` ID, a `YYYY-MM-DD` date, a bracketed tag list of one or more comma-separated kebab-case tokens, and the four named fields (Decision, Broke, Lesson, Links) each present as a `- **<Field>:**`-anchored line within the entry.
rationale: tags are the retrieval key and fields are the contract — silhouette checks let malformed entries read as conformant (#54 E7)
fit_criterion: empty-tag and non-kebab-tag fixtures red naming the entry; a field present only as an unanchored substring red; `I1` and the real registry green; graduation `Links:` growth still green; density and append-only fixtures keep their verdicts
